comments.author: Delear
comments.body:
Took 50 QMPs, and I have 220k fame. The quest chain up until this point has cost around 200. Certain quests just eat them up before they will spawn.

Additionally, I have found that certain city Guilds do not easily spawn the quests they are supposed to be available at, whereas a different city will do better. Moral for me is if there are multiple cities listed and you're having no success, change cities.
